input.title: iOS #50: updating over the N-1 store build resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the update-path checks in the QA Regression Runbook. Brian Foster ran it on Sep 30 ("Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135").

**Device / OS:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 store version (App Store), updated to iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50)

**Repro**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store.
2. Play past level 200. Brian's account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins.
3. Install TestFlight 50 over it and launch.

**Result:** the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. Relaunching doesn't bring it back.
**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks are kept across the update.

**Other update rows in the same run:**
- iOS N-2 -> #50: pass
- Android N-1 -> #135: pass
- Android N-2 -> #135: pass

Lost progress and coins is a blocker under the ZM submission rules. The runbook also says any failure in an UPDATE column blocks the release. Blocking the ZM store push (ZOM-570).

## QA gate blockers (Oct 1, Android #135 / iOS #50)
The full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Oct 1 - Android #135 / iOS #50". QA call: **NO-GO** until these are cleared.

- ZOM-581: updating over the N-1 store build to iOS #50 resets the save to level 1 (new, from the runbook update-path check)
- ZOM-578: tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
- ZOM-576: Season Pass premium tier claim drops the booster bundle (#50)
- ZOM-573: claiming the 5th Collect&Win chest crashes the app (#135)
- ZOM-569: Season Pass opens twice and leaves an empty screen. The fix landed on main after the Started lines, so it isn't in #135 or #50
- ZOM-567: Zombie Lane chests don't land in the inventory. Backend #36 code is on prod, but the rest isn't confirmed live
- ZOM-562: orphan items in boss arena. Players can't clear the board and lose a life (#135, plus the Cobalt playtest on #50)
- ZOM-560: abandoned pack purchase doesn't deliver the win streak freezer time (#135)
- ZOM-559: Samsung home-out freezes the victory screen (#133; not re-tested on #135)
- ZOM-554: quitting mid-tornado leaves the next level unplayable until a force-quit (#50)
- ZOM-546: endless refill drains the board and the run can't go on (#135 / #50)
- ZOM-483: new-install infinite lives time is lost on relaunch (#135)
- ZOM-449: low-end Android freezes on a cold start into level 3 (#135)
- ZOM-435: stuck on the trophy path after a fast double claim (#135, Leonard)
- DES-313: level 214 can't be completed, only 2 of 3 jars spawn (#135)

input.message:
QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO** as they stand. 15 blockers are listed on ZOM-570, and the full register is in the ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Oct 1 - Android #135 / iOS #50".

Blockers:
• **ZOM-581 (new):** the runbook update path fails. Installing #50 over the N-1 store build reset Brian's save from level 212 / 18.4k coins to level 1 / 500. N-2 and both Android update rows pass.
• **Still reproducing on the candidates:** ZOM-546 (endless board drains), ZOM-554 (quitting mid-tornado leaves the next level unplayable), ZOM-562 (orphan boss-arena items; the Cobalt playtest on TF50 had 3/6 players lose a life to it), ZOM-560 (abandoned pack freezer time not delivered), ZOM-483 (new-install infinite lives time lost), ZOM-449 (low-end freeze on level 3), DES-313 (level 214 can't be finished), ZOM-435 (trophy path stuck, Leonard on #135).
• **Filed against the candidates, not re-tested yet:** ZOM-573 (Collect&Win 5th chest crash), ZOM-576 (SP premium claim drops boosters), ZOM-578 (tutorial step 3 stuck on fresh install).
• **ZOM-569:** the Season Pass double-open fix landed on main at 21:36Z, after both Started lines, so it isn't in #135 or #50.
• **ZOM-567:** backend #36 code is on prod, but Douglas called that "the code side". It stays a blocker until the rest is confirmed live and re-checked on prod. Douglas, can you confirm?
• **ZOM-559:** the Samsung freeze from #133 hasn't been re-tested on #135 yet (needs a Samsung).

Fixed and verified: ZOM-503, 506, 557, 561, 434, 558, 564, 517, 429, and ZOM-563 on prod. 21 known issues are logged in the sheet.

With Friday as the deadline, getting to a go needs a new cut with the fixes, plus a clean re-run of the update path.
